newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea ambassador among hostages - foreign ministry.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea ambassador among hostages - foreign ministry.

text.p: South Korea's ambassador to Peru, Lee Won-young, is among the hostages held by a guerrilla group who stormed the Japanese embassy in Lima on Wednesday, an official at Seoul's Foreign Ministry said.
The official told Reuters other South Korean embassy officials had advised the foreign ministry of the ambassador's situation.

In Lima, a released hostage said the guerrillas were holding between 250 and 300 hostages. Sally Bowen, president of Peru's foreign press association, said she saw between 10 and 12 guerrillas but believed there were more.
The Seoul Foreign Ministry official said they did not know if other Korean embassy diplomats were among the hostages.

Bowen said the guerrillas demanded that the government release the estimated 400 to 500 Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrillas in prison, including leader Victor Polai; a review of Peru's judicial system and the beginning of negotiations with the government.
